Quick internal note and question for Emily (adding in thread so all get thread context).

High level guidance for planning Dedicated vs Hosted for the POC:
- Hosted trial: fastest setup, default quotas but can scale with temporary quota bumps. Good if you want no infra work and want a baseline of latency/cost.
- Dedicated (reserved pool): we can give a short reserved window for the POC (1–2 week reserved), gives predictable throughput and isolates load but requires a short provisioning window (we usually turn up GPUs ~24–48h after agreement).

For scheduling the load test I'd like these inputs from FinCloud before the call:
1) Peak concurrency by endpoint (or a simple split: short chat vs long report generation).
2) Token budget for the POC period (the attached workbook is helpful).
3) Any hard latency SLOs for particular routes.

If you can confirm those by EOD Monday we can have a concrete capacity recommendation at kickoff. Attaching our draft load‑test matrix.

—Ben
